description: Runs a Debug xcodebuild for an Xcode project and selected scheme.
name: xcodebuild-scheme-debug-build
systemInstruction:
Run xcodebuild for the selected project and scheme using the Debug configuration.

Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`.  If you find the makro `project_xcodeproj` between a double `{` and `}` replace `project_xcodeproj` including the makro marker with the user selected .xcodeproj path. If the user does not specify a project directory then use ${CHAT_PROJECT_DIR}.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_XCODEPROJ="{{project_xcodeproj}}"
SCHEME="{{schema}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" ] && [ "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" != "{{project_xcodeproj}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_xcodeproj" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "$SCHEME" ] && [ "$SCHEME" != "{{schema}}" ] || { echo "Missing schema" >&2; exit 1; }

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ")" && pwd)"

find "$PROJECT_DIR" -type f -name "*.backup" -delete
xattr -w com.apple.xcode.CreatedByBuildSystem true $PROJECT_DIR/build
xcodebuild -project "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" -scheme "$SCHEME" -configuration Debug build
```

Return the xcodebuild output.
